snippet.title: Track & Field (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Konami, Apr 1987 (Original Hardware)
snippet.description:
Track and Field was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in April 1987. All audio/visual elements copyright 1987, Konami. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/track-and-field/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT TRACK AND FIELD (NES)

Track & Field helped to popularize the button-mashing style of gameplay, in which a player must hit a button on their controller as fast and as many times as possible in order to make their in-game athlete move quicker. This design rapidly incorporated into clones like Epyx's Summer Games. Many contemporary athletics games still use this form of control as a part of their gameplay.

AKA: Track & Field in Barcelona, Hyper Olympic
